22 Cozy Fall Dinner Recipes

Warm, comforting meals made quick and easy for busy weeknights, chilly evenings, and nights when you just want something delicious without a lot of work!

September 23, 2026 By Lilly

161Shares
0
161

Instaread

There’s just something about a cold, dark evening that makes a warm and cozy dinner taste even better. Once fall rolls around, I’m ready to trade the lighter meals for cheesy casseroles, creamy pastas, hearty ground beef dinners, and anything that can simmer away in the slow cooker all day. These are the kinds of warm, filling meals that make everyone happy to come to the dinner table after a long day!

I put together a list of my favorite comfort food dinners that are especially good for busy fall and winter nights. Most are made with basic ingredients and don’t require a ton of prep or cleanup. And because feeding a family isn’t always easy, I also included plenty of picky-eater-friendly dinners. Save a few for those chilly nights when you’re tired, hungry, and completely out of ideas for dinner.

1. Forgotten Chicken

This creamy chicken and rice casserole is one of those classic cozy dinners that’s hard to beat on a chilly night. Just toss it in the oven and let it do its thing while you get on with the rest of your evening!

Ingredients

  • chicken breasts
  • minute rice
  • 2 cans creamy soup
  • Lipton onion soup mix
  • butter

Instructions: Forgotten Chicken Casserole

2. Cheesy Baked Tortellini

This is one of those easy dinners everyone is happy to see on the table! Tender tortellini, hearty meat sauce, and plenty of gooey melted cheese all baked together for a delicious meal that’s just as good leftover.

Ingredients

  • ground beef
  • fresh or frozen tortellini
  • pasta sauce
  • cream cheese
  • shredded mozzarella & parmesan
  • seasoning to taste (garlic powder, Italian, etc.)

Instructions: Cheesy Baked Tortellini

3. Chopped Cheeseburger Biscuits

Is grill season over? This unique casserole has all the flavors of a cheeseburger baked in the oven! Seasoned ground beef, cheddar, and fluffy biscuits make it a simple family dinner that’s especially good for picky eaters.

Ingredients

  • ground beef
  • refrigerated biscuits
  • shredded cheddar
  • seasoning to taste
  • small yellow onion (optional)

Instructions: Chopped Cheeseburger Biscuits

4. White Chicken Enchiladas

These creamy enchiladas are filled with rotisserie chicken and cream cheese, then smothered in a rich white sauce and baked until hot and bubbly. Always a hit with my family!

Ingredients

  • flour tortillas
  • rotisserie chicken
  • cream cheese & sour cream
  • shredded cheese
  • taco seasoning & garlic powder
  • chicken broth
  • diced green chiles
  • butter & flour

Instructions: White Chicken Enchiladas

5. Cheesy Tater Tot Casserole

This cozy casserole is loaded with meat, veggies, and potatoes all in one delicious dish! Who doesn’t love crispy tater tots piled all over their dinner? It’s the ultimate comfort food.

Ingredients

  • frozen tater tots
  • ground beef
  • yellow onion
  • canned green beans
  • cream of mushroom soup
  • shredded cheddar
  • Worcestershire sauce
  • seasoning to taste

Instructions: Cheesy Tater Tot Casserole

6. Lazy Shepherd’s Pie

This classic dinner is made with just a handful of budget ingredients layered into a large casserole dish. It will make your house smell amazing and leave everyone with full bellies by the end of the night.

Ingredients

  • leftover, boxed, or homemade mashed potatoes
  • ground beef
  • frozen mixed veggies
  • tomato soup
  • packet beef stew seasoning mix
  • shredded cheddar

Instructions: Lazy Shepherd’s Pie

7. Creamy Chicken Taco Soup

Just toss everything into your slow cooker and come back to a warm, creamy soup loaded with shredded chicken and lots of taco flavor. It’s an easy, hearty dinner for chilly nights, especially topped with crunchy tortilla chips!

Ingredients

  • chicken breasts
  • packet chicken taco seasoning
  • chicken broth
  • canned diced tomatoes & green chilies
  • canned corn
  • canned black beans
  • shredded cheddar & heavy cream

Instructions: Creamy Chicken Taco Soup

8. Cheeseburger Pasta Casserole

This heavenly pasta bake combines ground beef, pasta shells, tomato soup, and plenty of cheese for a simple dinner that tastes like pure comfort food. It’s a family favorite around here and always a good choice when you’ve got picky kids to feed!

Ingredients

  • ground beef
  • pasta shells
  • tomato soup
  • shredded cheese
  • seasoning to taste

Instructions: Cheeseburger Pasta Casserole

9. Meatball Pot Roast

A budget-friendly dinner that has all the cozy flavor of a pot roast without the expensive cut of meat! Frozen meatballs cook low and slow in the crockpot with veggies and a savory gravy for an easy dinner that tastes way better than you’d expect.

Ingredients

  • frozen meatballs
  • baby carrots & celery
  • a few packets brown gravy mix
  • Lipton onion soup mix
  • butter
  • mashed potatoes

Instructions: Frozen Meatball Pot Roast

10. Creamy Sausage Tortellini Soup

This hearty soup is loaded with savory sausage and tender pasta for a warm, filling dinner on a cold night. Make it in the slow cooker or right on the stovetop for an easy bowl of comfort food the whole family can enjoy. Don’t forget the garlic toast!

Ingredients

  • ground sausage
  • vegetable broth
  • a few cans Italian diced tomatoes
  • cream cheese
  • fresh or frozen tortellini
  • fresh spinach

Instructions: Creamy Sausage Tortellini Soup

11. Chicken & Stuffing Casserole

A popular chicken dinner that has all those yummy Thanksgiving flavors without waiting for the holidays! Everything bakes together into a simple yet tasty dinner that makes the whole house smell amazing.

Ingredients

  • rotisserie chicken
  • zucchini
  • Stove Top stuffing mix
  • butter
  • can cream chicken soup
  • sour cream

Instructions: Chicken & Stuffing Casserole

12. Stuffing Meatloaf

This old-fashioned meatloaf uses a box of stuffing for a clever shortcut that adds tons of flavor without a long list of ingredients. It’s a simple, hearty dinner that feels like something Grandma would have made!

Ingredients

  • ground beef
  • Stove Top stuffing mix
  • eggs
  • ketchup
  • water or milk

Instructions: Stuffing Meatloaf

13. Chicken Biscuit Cobbler

Creamy, hearty, and topped with buttery biscuits that bake up golden and delicious, this casserole is pure comfort food. It’s an easy baked dinner that really hits the spot on a cold night when you’re craving something warm and filling.

Ingredients

  • stick of butter
  • rotisserie chicken
  • frozen mixed veggies
  • Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuit Mix
  • milk
  • chicken broth
  • cream chicken soup
  • seasoning to taste

Instructions: Chicken Biscuit Cobbler

14. Creamy Sausage Pasta

Looking for a yummy pasta idea? This one is loaded with savory sausage and a rich, creamy sauce for a quick dinner that really hits the spot. It comes together fast and makes a warm, filling meal for cold evenings at home.

Ingredients

  • any pasta
  • ground sausage
  • minced garlic
  • heavy cream
  • butter
  • spinach
  • parmesan cheese

Instructions: Creamy Sausage Pasta

15. Lazy Lasagna

All the cheesy, saucy goodness of homemade lasagna without all the work! This easy shortcut dinner comes together with frozen ravioli layered into a casserole dish for a cozy family meal that even picky eaters will happily dig into.

Ingredients

  • frozen ravioli
  • large jar pasta sauce
  • shredded mozzarella

Instructions: Lazy Lasagna

16. Cheesy Beef & Potato Casserole

Frozen potatoes make this cheesy ground beef casserole extra fast to throw together on a busy school night. It’s a budget-friendly dinner made with common ingredients that will fill up the whole family without much work!

Ingredients

  • ground beef
  • bag frozen cubed potatoes with onions & peppers
  • can of cheddar soup
  • can cream of celery soup
  • shredded cheddar
  • seasoning to taste

Instructions: Cheesy Beef & Potato Casserole

17. Cheesy Chicken & Broccoli Bake

Chicken, broccoli, creamy rice, and lots of melted cheese all baked together with a crunchy, buttery corn flake topping. Super tasty and versatile! You can use any type of chicken or veggie.

Ingredients

  • canned chicken breast
  • frozen broccoli
  • cooked rice
  • cream of chicken soup
  • sour cream
  • shredded cheddar
  • corn flakes
  • butter & seasoning to taste

Instructions: Cheesy Chicken Broccoli Bake

18. Mini Chicken Pot Pies

These little pot pies are made with just four ingredients, making them effortless to throw together in a muffin pan. They’re warm, creamy, and fun to eat!

Ingredients

  • canned chicken breast
  • frozen mixed veggies
  • cream of chicken soup
  • refrigerated biscuits
  • optional seasoning

Instructions: Mini Chicken Pot Pies

19. Cheesy Taco Macaroni

Taco night meets cheesy pasta in this hearty ground beef dinner. Simply toss seasoned ground beef with a can of diced tomatoes and few boxes of your favorite macaroni and cheese. It doesn’t get any easier than this!

Ingredients

  • ground beef
  • taco seasoning
  • a few boxes Velveeta Mac & Cheese
  • canned diced tomatoes with green chilies

Instructions: Cheesy Taco Mac

20. Cheesy Meatball Rice Casserole

Frozen meatballs, instant rice, pasta sauce, and plenty of gooey cheese all bake together in one dish for a lazy night dinner. Everything cooks right in the casserole dish, so you get a cozy family meal without a sink full of dishes afterward!

Ingredients

  • instant rice
  • pasta sauce
  • Italian diced tomatoes
  • frozen meatballs
  • shredded mozzarella
  • parmesan
  • Italian seasoning & garlic powder

Instructions: Cheesy Meatball Rice Casserole

21. Crockpot Chicken & Gravy

Tender shredded chicken cooks in a rich, creamy gravy for one of those dinners that tastes like you spent way more time on it. Spoon it over mashed potatoes, rice, or pasta for a warm meal the whole family can dig into!

Ingredients

  • chicken breasts
  • a few packets chicken gravy mix
  • cream chicken soup
  • sour cream
  • seasoning to taste
  • mashed potatoes, rice, or pasta for serving

Instructions: Crockpot Chicken & Gravy

22. The Easiest Pot Roast

Three simple seasoning packets give this pot roast tons of flavor with hardly any effort. Just toss everything in the slow cooker and let it do all the work while your house fills with that amazing, cozy Sunday dinner smell!

Ingredients

  • beef chuck roast
  • brown gravy mix
  • ranch seasoning mix
  • Italian dressing mix
  • water
  • vegetables of choice

Instructions: The Easiest Pot Roast
